testName: DreamHouse: Mortgage Calculator LWC Amortization Calculation
steps:
1. Open Property record with Price "$750,000"
2. Locate embedded "Mortgage Calculator" LWC component
3. Verify Principal Amount auto-populates "$750,000"
4. In Down Payment input, enter "$150,000" (20%)
5. Select Loan Term "30 Years Fixed"
6. Enter Annual Interest Rate "6.5%"
7. Verify calculated Monthly Payment displays "$3,792.41"
8. Change Interest Rate to "5.5%"
9. Verify Monthly Payment dynamically recalculates to "$3,406.73" immediately
